November 15, 2026

LAFMAT en China: fortaleciendo la cooperación científica internacional

Leer noticia

🎓 Participación de la Red LAFMAT en la Conferencia CIEP 2026

La Red Latinoamericana de Física de la Materia Condensada y Ciencia de Materiales (LAFMAT) participa en la Conferencia CIEP 2026, celebrada en Kunming, China.

El Prof. Dr. Luis De Los Santos Valladares, presidente de la Red LAFMAT, presentó la conferencia titulada “LAFMAT: A Latin American Experience in Building an International Network for Condensed Matter Physics and Materials Science”, destacando las oportunidades de cooperación científica entre América Latina y China.

La presentación busca fortalecer los vínculos académicos internacionales y promover nuevas oportunidades de colaboración en investigación, formación de recursos humanos e intercambio científico.

📅 Fecha: 14 de noviembre de 2026

📍 Lugar: Kunming, China

🎤 Conferencista: Prof. Dr. Luis De Los Santos Valladares

📸 En la imagen, el presidente de LAFMAT presenta la red y sus perspectivas de cooperación científica internacional ante los participantes de la conferencia.

December 05 ,2024

DESY | Summer Student Programme 2025

Leer noticia

📅 Programme Dates: 22 July – 11 September 2025

📰 Update (05 December 2024):The online application is now open and will remain open until 31 January 2025.

Each summer, DESY offers undergraduate students in physics and related disciplines (including scientific computing and engineering) the opportunity to gain first-hand research experience at a large international laboratory.

Selected students will participate in an 8-week research training programme at DESY (Hamburg or Zeuthen, near Berlin), joining the daily work of research groups in areas such as:

Photon Science

Photon Science

Elementary Particle Physics & Accelerators

Elementary Particle Physics & Accelerators

Astroparticle Physics

Astroparticle Physics

Research activities may include experimental work on detectors and instrumentation, physics data analysis, software development, theory, and scientific computing.

In addition to the research project, participants will attend a series of lectures (in English), as well as guided visits to accelerators, experiments, and the computing centre. Students are expected to work 39 hours per week (including project and lectures).

🏠 Accommodation: Free housing at the DESY Hostel during the full programme period💰 Financial Support: Adequate funding to cover living expenses

🔗 For further details and application information, please visit the official DESY webpage.📧 Contact: summie-org@desy.de
